# <a id="tag-1"></a><a id="tag-2"></a>Pacifists

### Description

A Pacifist is someone who prefers not to use violence to\
achieve their ends. There are two types of Pacifists:

[Peace-mage](c_peacemag.md)\
[Trapper](c_trapper.md)
